name: buildScriptGuidance/exact-model-visible-block
out_json:
"## Emit a script (one turn) instead of many tool calls
Use a script when you face a mechanical sequence of ≥3 steps with no decision between them:
setup, batch renames, run-and-filter pipelines, install-then-test, generate-then-move.
Prefer TypeScript (runs natively on Bun — use for any logic, parsing, or branching).
Use bash only for plain command chains with no real logic.
One script = one turn: write the full program, run it once, read the result.
Print only what the next decision needs; write bulk output to files and print their paths.
Do not emit a script for exploratory reads or any step that needs mid-sequence judgment."
